description: Payload breaks its JSON Schema contract (enum or pattern)
One TrackID per ShipmentUnit in each VeloShip message
Every TrackID of events and invoices exists in a shipment; invoiced parcels were picked up; delivered parcels are invoiced; invoiced customers exist
Scan sequence DATA_RECEIVED > PICKUP > HUB (1-3) > IN_DELIVERY > DELIVERED; CANCELLED only before PICKUP
No repeated scan with the same TrackID; status and GLN
recordTime >= eventTime and at most 15 minutes later; every active country records scans every day
Scan GLN is a depot; the last DELIVERED scan is in the consignee zone
netAmount = basePrice + surcharges; totals.net = sum of lines; gross = net + vat
basePrice = band price of the tariff valid on the shipping date; FUEL = basePrice x fuelSurchargePct / 100
Credit notes are negative and reference an existing invoice
Ledger revenue per country and month = invoice revenue in EUR (0.5%)
fxRateToEur = 1 in EUR; otherwise the rate of the issue date (REF.FX_RATE_DAILY)
deliveredParcels = DELIVERED scans of the partner zone and month
totalCost = stops x costPerStop; stops <= deliveredParcels
Weight bands start at 0 and are contiguous with increasing prices; no overlapping validity per customer product and zone
Valid GS1 check digit in GLN and SSCC; vatNumber prefix = countryCode
Each zone has exactly one partner
Lead country is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (silver normalises it but the source is flagged)
